files.services/catalogue.md:
# Service catalogue

- checkout-api: owned by Storefront, pager rotation in oncall/.
- search-indexer: owned by Discovery, pager rotation in oncall/.
- billing: owned by Revenue Platform. Moved to the Revenue Platform pager tool on 2026-09-01; not in the shared rota.
- billing-legacy: decommissioned 2026-08-15, rotation kept until the Q4 rota is regenerated.
- notifications: owned by Messaging, pager rotation in oncall/.

turns.prompt: A payment reconciliation job is going to run against the billing service during the week of October 13. Who is on call for billing that week?
